subject: Re: Demo follow-up — token targets & model mix
content:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria@acme-retail.com>, Chris Patel <chris@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up — token targets & model mix

Hi Maria / Chris — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

Summary of your needs (as we heard it)
- Use case: customer-facing product search + conversational assistant for checkout help + occasional ranking/rerank for product lists.
- Expected traffic: ~2.0M LLM queries/month to start, growth to ~5M in 12 months (linear ramp).
- Query profile (approx):
  - Search embedding requests: ~50% of queries, average embedding input ~400 tokens
  - Chat prompts (assistant): ~35% of queries, average round-trip ~600 tokens (prompt + response)
  - Rerank calls: ~15% of queries, small prompt size ~120 tokens
- Budget target: team indicated $/1M tokens target in the $120–$180 range; procurement prefers an upper bound for initial quote.

Model mix we recommended on the call (we can adjust):
- Embeddings: 50% of token volume, using redwood-embed-5 (dense 512)
- Chat: 35% of token volume, using redwood-chat-8b for lower-cost paths; fall back to redwood-chat-xxl for high-fidelity when required
- Rerank: 15% of token volume, using redwood-rerank-2

Two asks for you so we can produce a formal quote:
1) Confirm the monthly query volume you want quoted for year-1 (you said ~2M; is that billed queries or user sessions?)
2) Narrow target $/1M tokens range (you mentioned $120–$180; what is your procurement hard ceiling?)

Attached: token-econ-sheet-v1.xlsx (blended estimates by model) and a draft proposal (redwood-proposal-draft.pdf).

If that all looks right I’ll scope a formal quote and a recommended mutual action plan (dates for procurement, pilot, and production milestones). Can we aim for a quick procurement sync next week?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: token-econ-sheet-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: redwood-proposal-draft.pdf (pdf)]

From: Maria Gonzalez <maria@acme-retail.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Chris Patel <chris@acme-retail.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up — token targets & model mix

Thanks Jordan — quick clarifications from our side: 
- The 2.0M number is LLM queries (not user sessions). Good to confirm you used that as the base.
- For embeddings, our search index will be the dominant consumer; embedding input tends to be shorter on average for product snippets (~300–450 tokens).
- For chat, 600 tokens average sounds about right for initial scope.
- Procurement: our internal target is $150/1M tokens as the center of budget planning, with a hard ceiling of $190/1M for the first year of the pilot.

We’re ok with the proposed model mix but need to understand per-model unit economics before committing. Procurement also asked for a simple per-month spend estimate and a breakdown by model so they can start their internal approval.

Can you show two price scenarios: (A) hosted API on usage-based pricing, (B) a 12-month committed (reserved) capacity discount? Procurement expects a decision rubric by next Friday.

Also attaching our procurement window and timeline.

—Maria
Director, Product
Acme Retail
[Attachment: acme-procurement-window.pdf (pdf)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria@acme-retail.com>, Chris Patel <chris@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up — token targets & model mix

Great — thanks for the clarity, Maria. Per your ask below, I ran two quick scenarios in the attached sheet. High-level numbers here (ballpark, will formalize in the quote):

Assumptions: 2.0M queries/month (year 1), token distributions per the call, token counts as above.

Scenario A — Hosted (usage-based) estimates (list price / 1M tokens):
- redwood-chat-8b: $85 / 1M tokens
- redwood-chat-xxl: $220 / 1M tokens (used for ~10% of chat when high fidelity required)
- redwood-embed-5: $28 / 1M tokens
- redwood-rerank-2: $55 / 1M tokens

Blended math (2M queries/month => ~600M tokens/month aggregate across all types) using the call mix yields a blended list-price of approximately $160 / 1M tokens. With standard volume-based tiering and expected caching savings we can target an effective blended of $120–$135 / 1M tokens on a hosted plan for year-1.

Scenario B — 12mo committed (reserved) estimate:
- We can offer a 15–25% discount off hosted list price depending on commit size and whether you opt for burst capacity. That would push the blended effective to roughly $95–$115 / 1M tokens for the same volumes.

Notes / levers to drive costs down:
- Increase prefix/KV caching on the chat paths (reduces token consumption for repeated system prompts).
- Use redwood-chat-8b for most assistant traffic and reserve xx-large for only the top 5–10% highest-quality queries.
- Quantized variants for embeddings can lower embedding unit cost if accuracy tradeoffs acceptable.

Next steps I suggest: 
1) I’ll prepare a formal two-option quote (A: hosted usage tier; B: 12mo reserve) with per-model line items and total monthly/annual numbers.
2) Lauren will share an outline for a mutual action plan and suggested commit bands that map to discount tiers.
3) Schedule a 30-min procurement review to walk the finance team through the blended spend and the commit math (next Wed or Thu proposed).

If this aligns I’ll send the formal quote by EOD Friday.

Jordan
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: token-econ-sheet-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

Jordan — wrote down a quick MAP framework for this deal and a recommendation on commit bands. Copying Neha for pricing approval and legal redlining.

High level MAP items:
- Pilot (30 days): 2M queries/month on hosted; 30% discount on list for pilot with SLA baseline
- Production commit (12mo): option to convert pilot usage into a 12mo reserved contract with tiered discounts (15% for 12–24M/mo effective, 20% for 25–50M/mo, 25%+ above).
- Security/contract items: SOC2 evidence + VPC option for dedicated private plane; legal to push standard MSA with data residency appendix.

Action items for Jordan: finalize per-model line items in the formal quote and include a short appendix showing how the blended $/1M changes with commit bands.
Action items for Neha: confirm the maximum standard discount we can approve without escalation and any one-time onboarding credits we can offer.

Lauren

Thanks all — this is helpful. Procurement signaled we should proceed with a formal quote. A couple quick asks before you finalize: 
- Please show two blended outcomes: (1) our current plan at 2M queries/mo; (2) a conservative ramp to 4M queries/mo (so we can see the sensitivity).
- For model mix we prefer embeddings-heavy for search: revise to Embeddings 50%, Chat 40%, Rerank 10% (that will change the blended math).
- Procurement wants the reserved 12mo pricing included with an explicit commit band that maps to a target of ~$100/1M effective or better — can you show whether a 20–25% discount band would get us there?

If you can get the quote and MAP appendix in by Friday we’ll route to legal and procurement. Also open to the procurement review meeting next Wed.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.
